review_type: source-grounded AI review; not physician adjudication
reviewed_components: all clinical facts and measured quantities
corrections: p1-f023 community-acquired pneumonia: assertion unknown -> absent, verification unknown -> refuted (source: "incorrectly diagnosed"); name trimmed to the concept.
p1-f082 AI lung tumor lesion: assertion unknown -> absent, verification unknown -> refuted (source: "mistakenly diagnosed"); radiologist "probably neoplastic" item kept as possible.
p1-f029 smoking status unknown -> current ("has never quit smoking"); removed the ambiguity that forbade inferring current smoking.
p1-f113 suspected AFOP assertion present -> possible (provisional kept).
Added p1-f130 observation: histologic diagnosis not performed ("lack of histologic diagnosis").
Added literal b00011 quotes to p1-f120 (cough disappeared) and p1-f121 (reexamination CT).
Removed relation e04->e05 (seeing a doctor vs hospitalization not literally ordered; source conflicts on where the empirical therapy was given).
Added relations e03->e04 (therapy proved ineffective / no relief) and e10->e14 (no negative reactions to the steroids at the 6-month checkup); added the "Initially" quote to e03->e10.
Summary claim 1: "had been incorrectly diagnosed" -> "was incorrectly diagnosed" (pluperfect implied an unsupported order).
Ambiguities: rewrote the CAP/AI item for the refuted representation; added the empirical-therapy setting conflict and the pulse/heart-rate double statement.
Cleared irrelevant CA-129 notes on CEA and NSE.
unresolved: Figure panels were pixel-inspected in the separate visual submission; the annotation figures keep caption-level status not_inspected.
The case text gives no calendar dates and almost no time anchors: the CT, laboratory tests and bronchoscopy are not placed relative to admission, so their times stay null.
AFOP is a suspected diagnosis from lavage-fluid cytology; the authors state there was no histologic diagnosis.
The captions print "mediation window", read in the visual submission as printed without correcting it.
Background and discussion statements about cavitary lung disease, tuberculosis, abscess, lung cancer and a previous AFOP case are not patient facts.
No supplements are listed in the source.

key_findings: Incorrect CAP and mistaken AI tumor diagnoses recorded as refuted by the authors statement; EVID-NEGATION warnings are checker false positives.
Lab ranges printed without classification: no high/low flags set.
Pulse and heart rate kept as two printed statements; mNGS abstract/result merged as one test; caption sizes kept separate from text diameters.
residual_risks: Location of the empirical CAP therapy relative to hospitalization is contradictory in the source.
Antibiotic discontinued by the MDT is not named and is not equated with moxifloxacin.
Printed oddities kept as printed (CA-129, L%/E% with absolute units, "no touch of the liver, spleen and ribs", "mediation window").
